title: DXA-measured body composition effects of GLP-1 and dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonists in adults with obesity or type 2 diabetes: analysis code and data (version 2.0, revised for BMC Endocrine Disorders)
description: Data and R code for the systematic review and meta-analysis of phase 3 randomized trials reporting DXA-derived lean body mass and fat mass with GLP-1 and dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonists (PROSPERO CRD420261323497). Version 2.0 (September 2026) accompanies the revised manuscript submitted to BMC Endocrine Disorders: three lean-mass values (STEP-1, LEAD-2, LEAD-3) were corrected after re-verification against the primary source tables during peer review; the data file documents the source table for every value and the originally submitted data are retained as data_raw_v1_submitted.csv. The analysis (glp1_dxa_meta_v1_2.R, revision_analyses.R) implements the REML + Hartung-Knapp-Sidik-Jonkman primary model, prediction intervals, tau-squared estimator comparison, profile-likelihood intervals, robust variance estimation, a three-level model, leave-one-out and expanded-inclusion analyses, small-study-effect diagnostics (Egger, Begg, Doi plot/LFK via metasens) and Bayesian random-effects models (brms, bayesmeta). All outputs (tables, figures, console log) are included; see README.md and CHANGELOG.md.
